registeredBefore: the first S3 build step (protocol B4; handoff 'Do first' item 5)
authority: owner master prompt (S3 reduced build) + Patch 1 (branch setup) + Patch 2 (owner decisions 1-6)
estimateRange: 70-130 M all-processed tokens (protocol B4: the reduced-S3 range; midpoint chosen)
unit: all-processed tokens (input + cache-read + cache-write + output), measured by lib/greenfield/usage.js over THIS session's transcript plus every subagent transcript the harness writes beside it
measuredAs: DELTA from the S3 start snapshot (the 2,000,000 absolute start test was waived by the owner in Patch 2: each message re-reads a ~120K fixed prefix, so ~2.3M accrues during setup alone)
checkCadence: a snapshot after EVERY numbered step and after every subagent returns; the cap covers all subagents; a snapshot that cannot be taken stops the run

ieq.label: ratio estimate (published pricing ratios; relative cost unit, NOT money)

dollarEstimate: none: no official price page has been fetched; no dollar figure is reported

cleanContextTest.rule: latest assistant message cache-read <= 250,000 tokens at the start of the run (Patch 2 item 2); recorded at every snapshot as the prefix size, which is a cost driver

model: claude-sonnet-5-5 (main session; subagents inherit unless stated)
